Software Engineer - New Grad, Storage (2027 Start)

Austin, Texas

P-101

At Initech we build storage systems that keep enormous amounts of data safe and fast.

As a new grad engineer you will join a team that owns one layer of that system end to end.

  • Query planning and execution
  • Transaction coordination across regions

What we look for:

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, finished by 2027
  • Comfort with at least one systems language such as Go, Rust, or C++

About Initech

Initech makes software for teams that run on data, with offices worldwide.
